notes.title: v0.8.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Just a quick update here addressing some issues with the new Otherworld mechanics and some other random things!

 Fixed Killstick Turrets shoot speed not being framerate independent and shooting like lasers
 Fixed mouse up/down not being framerate independent in gameplay camera
 Fixed controller camera movement being effected by framerate
 Swings in Reliquary are no longer affected by ghosts
 Fixed Next Level button in marathons reading Main Menu
 Fixed spelling mistake on keybinding page
 Updated input manager (ReWired) to support more controllers and improve stability
 Can now rebind movement controls and general movement axes

notes.title: v0.7.7 - The big audio update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8677420/e1eb3e03c01445d3b7784124b5e28170020c14e3.jpg

We've been hard at work designing and implemeting new sound effects and cleaning up the triggers for existing sound effects. We also took a good long look at controller focus issues and cleaned that up a ton.

While doing all this polish the new Sector and multiplayer have been finishing up development and will be released soon! Hoping to get the new levels out in the next patch in a week or two.


General
Keybindings now save between sessions!
Follow cam is now on by default
Changed follow cam default start speed to 30, was 20

Levels
Tweaked Teeter gold par time
Fixed Meteor Storm from not starting
Water camera is now set correctly, this means the little white stuff around land displays cleaner
If you switch to controller UI now focuses correctly
Settings page is now totally usable with a controller

Audio
Finish line now makes a sound again
Added lava geyser sound effect
Added stone geyser sound effect
Added turret sound effect
Added hammer weapon sound effect
Added lance weapon sound effect
Added laser weapon sound effect
Added pistol weapon sound effect
Added mortar weapon sound effect
Fixed up shard sound effect
Added audio for UI events (focus, click, back)

Main Menu
Added tooltips to main menu global navigation buttons
Pressing B on customize page now takes you back to the home page
Pressing B on settings page now takes you back to the home page
Pressing B on profile page now takes you back to the home page
Pressing B while changing an option works correctly
Tweaked the way the global nav elements work and how focusing works with them using a controller
Fixed controller button icons not hiding/showing correctly based on input mode
Fixed keybinding screen colors
Going from level -> level select page now correctly focuses the appropriate button
Can now use a controller to view the profile page
Made profile image slightly bigger
Filled out the credits page, not finished yet

Level Editor
Fixed custom meshes not loading when you subscribe to a level
Fixed shards being broken
Improved snow particle system
Multiselect no longer selects base terrains

notes.title: v0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
IT'S FINALLY HERE!!!

After a long delay, the multiplayer patch is now released! We've talked about it in detail in previous posts, so we'll save some time and summarize the additions in this one.

Also, hopefully this doesn't upset anyone, but we feel like the game is starting to really come together, so we'll be wiping a few save files and removing the beta buttons (unlock all levels, free shards).

Here's the save data that will be wiped, and some reasoning.

	Shards: SORRY. There's no clear way to tell who used the "give me shards" button, and who legitimately collected shards. 
	Unlocked skin pieces: Unlimited shards meant unlimited skin pieces. Your loadouts will still have the same pieces, but don't switch them or else it's permanent (YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED)
	Level progression: We'll be activating the level progression gates with this patch, which means you'll need to have earned some medals before progressing to later sectors.
	Ghosts + scores: Same reason we're doing a leaderboard wipe. New physics means all the old data is obsolete now.


Okay the grim stuff is out of the way, now here's the notes!

General

	Added three new game modes: Circuit, Battle, Free Roam
	All the settings have gone through a QA pass, everything should be fixed up now
	Keybindings page clean up, support added for mouse buttons
	Debug menu bound to F3 and improved (a little bit)
	Added input direction/force UI under the ball. Next patch this will be toggleable
	Updated loading screen look/content
	Updated the multiplayer pause menu to act as more of a control panel


Ball Controls + Physics

	Fixed the speed exploit
	Change the ball movement system significantly - before it was applying force on the horizontal plane to push the ball around, now it applies angular velocity (spin) to the ball. This should make it more responsive and handle inclines more realistically.
	Lowered jump movement - the amount you can move in the air is significantly reduced, rolling off the start is faster, and you can platform more accurately. 
	Added a force follow cam button that will lock the camera behind you, this is default shift on a keyboard, and right bumper on a controller


Story Mode

	Sectors are now be locked behind a medal count
	Leaderboards reset and saved times have been cleared
	Level changes
	- Added small platform to 1-6
	- Removed a light from the beginning of 1-9
	- Tweaked wall run in Remains
	- Tweaked Past Mistake platform length


New Levels

	3 Circuit levels
	5 Battle levels (multiplayer only)
	5 Free roam levels (four based off of story mode sectors, one in an alternate universe)
	Added procedural level prototype, super super rough - but you can find it in Extra Levels > Test
	Combat system added, with 6 weapons and 12 abilities (used mainly in battle mode)


Local Multiplayer (split-screen)

	Up to 4 players
	Play on any level
	Voting system to pick levels


Online Multiplayer

	Join a server of up to 8 players
	Hub based lobbies (have a fallback free roam level, if someone needs to AFK)
	Also uses the voting system to pick levels


Skins

	Models
	- Real Cube ball - it is really a cube
	- Cage
	- Tessellate
	- Classic car, this is a prototype of a non-rotating skin module
	Effects
	- Ghost
	- Wraith
	- Gargantua
	- Cape
	Textures
	- Flashy (pretty buggy)

	
Website

	New Studio Monolith site
	New Polyball site
	Fixed leaderboards
	We've also worked out a roadmap to v1.0, let us know what you think!


There will be a patch tomorrow with some big bug fixes/changes, which include:

	Circuit level's single player spawns
	Online multiplayer UI scaling
	Controller fixes in main menu + game UI
	Story mode level requirements and pars rebalance (your number of medals will automatically adjust to any changes)

notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Just writing this to break the silence and let you guys know what's been going on. We've got a big update coming up so there's quite a bit to talk about.

First of all, sorry for the delay. We said we'd have v0.3 out over a month ago. I'll take most of the blame since the holdup has been related to the codebase (plus being kinda lazy these past two months, that's over though). Lots of the code has been refactored to pave the way to v1.0, since it was getting rough working with what we had. Nothing noticeable in the end, but it should improve workflow which is always nice.

Also, the leaderboards. We fixed a speed bug with the last patch, and were planning to wipe the leaderboards with the next patch. Since the next patch is taking so long, some times with the bugs are still up there. We've redone the core movement/control system, so we're doing a full wipe of the scores with v0.3. Bear with us until then!

Alright let's talk a bit about v0.3 now.


 Multiplayer + Combat

This is the big part of the patch. Multiplayer will be fully ready to play, both local split-screen and online.

There will be three game modes for now:

Sprint - For now these will just be all the single player levels, get from point A to point B
Circuit - Basic lap based levels, no surprises here (available for single player too)
Battle - Last man standing combat, with weapons and abilities


There are also hubs used for online, where players are free to roam around while the host picks the level. We'll probably add some fun stuff into them later, but for now there's a pad with all the abilities and weapons on it.  

Combat is a big addition. Players get a health bar, and try to make all the other ones disappear with a mix of weapons and abilities. Ramming into other people works too if that's the way you roll.

Weapons are a permanent pickup/selection, and will never expire. Right now there are three melee weapons, and three ranged. Two of the ranged weapons use ammo, which can be refilled from pickups on the ground. If you pick up ammo for a weapon that doesn't need it, you'll get overcharge, which will empower the next attack you do.

Abilities exist on a timer. When you pick one up, you'll have 30 seconds to get the most use out of it. We've got about a dozen in right now, ranging from speed boosts, to stealth, to shields.


Controls

One big change is the previously mentioned movement/controls. The ball was moved using kind of a "push" force, and the friction with the ground is what caused it to roll. We've completely changed that now. Unless you're in the air, the ball will be given torque, instead of the push we used before. It's a big change, but we feel like it's improved the game overall.

We're still messing around with the default control bindings as well. They're a mess right now because of all the new combat features, but we'll figure out how to streamline it better.

The camera got some work done it too. We added a button to snap on the auto-follow, which is really useful and I highly recommend getting comfortable with it. We're making a new tutorial level which will cover stuff like this.



Most of the patch is ready, but there's still a few things to do before we put it out. We might wait for the new Unity patch which is coming next week sometime, since it fixes a memory leak, but we could also use an older version without the leak. So the patch day is "sometime next week probably". Stay tuned!
